mapper.insert: MERGE INTO wo_user_workbook_mark T USING (SELECT CAST(#{userKey} AS VARCHAR) AS USER_KEY, CAST(#{workbookSeq} AS BIGINT) AS WORKBOOK_SEQ) S ON (T.USER_KEY = S.USER_KEY AND T.WORKBOOK_SEQ = S.WORKBOOK_SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STARRED_YN = #{starredYn}, COLOR_CODE = #{colorCode}, MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_KEY, WORKBOOK_SEQ, STARRED_YN, COLOR_CODE, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{workbookSeq}, #{starredYn}, #{colorCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} )
